sentences.text: An artificial intelligence firm downloaded for free millions of copyrighted books in digital form from pirate sites on the internet.
sentences.rationale: 交代AI公司从盗版网站免费下载数百万册受版权保护电子书的核心事实

sentences.text: the use of the books at issue to train Claude and its precursors was exceedingly transformative and was a fair use under Section 107 of the Copyright Act.
sentences.rationale: 法院认定用涉案图书训练Claude及其前身具高度转换性，依版权法第107条构成合理使用

sentences.text: This order grants summary judgment for Anthropic that the training use was a fair use.
sentences.rationale: 裁定就模型训练构成合理使用部分支持Anthropic的简易判决动议

sentences.text: But it denies summary judgment for Anthropic that the pirated library copies must be treated as training copies.
sentences.rationale: 裁定驳回Anthropic请求将盗版馆藏副本视为训练副本的简易判决动议

sentences.text: We will have a trial on the pirated copies used to create Anthropic’s central library and the resulting damages, actual or statutory (including for willfulness).
sentences.rationale: 裁定就用于建立中央图书馆的盗版副本及损害赔偿问题进入庭审
